text: Find a current finance manager who can support capital planning and allocation, build and integrate financial models, use SAP for data-driven decisions, and improve business processes in a manufacturing environment.

Find a current application or technical architect with hands-on full-stack engineering experience in Python and Django, modern JavaScript or React, relational and document databases, AWS and Docker infrastructure, data modeling, migrations, and automated testing practices.

Find an operations leader for an oil-industry analytical laboratory who has managed technicians, scheduling, purchasing, contracts, customer relationships, laboratory safety, sample analysis workflows, bookkeeping or budgeting, and can show process improvements or successful patents.

Find a current sales professional with international and North American account experience selling print media, packaging, or equipment, including import-export procurement, freight logistics, distribution, contract negotiation, and evidence of strong sales performance.

Find an entrepreneurship or product-innovation professional with hands-on experience founding a sustainable footwear startup, setting product vision from user research, sourcing sustainable materials, coordinating design and manufacturing, managing ESG compliance and supply-chain risk, and winning grants or startup awards.
